testsuite.name: com.slotting.admin.auth.PasswordResetSecurityTest

testcase.name: TC-05 successful password reset invalidates all other active reset tokens for that player()
TC-01 happy path end-to-end secure single-use email password reset()
TC-04 concurrent redemption of same reset token permits exactly one success()
TC-10 immediate reuse of current active password is prevented()
TC-06 CSRF protection rejects mismatched or missing CSRF tokens()
TC-09 rate limiting throttles rapid repeat requests and prevents email bombing()
TC-02 account enumeration protection returns identical generic response for all conditions()
TC-07 password policy enforces min 15 chars, max 64 chars, and blocks common passwords()
TC-03 expired reset token is strictly rejected()
TC-08 host header injection defense generates links strictly from configured origin()
